title: Design.
officialText:
Allowable bearing pressures, allowable stresses and design formulas provided in this chapter shall be
used with the allowable stress design load combinations specified in Section 1605.3. The quality and design of materials
used structurally in excavations and foundations shall conform to the requirements specified in Chapters 16, 19, 21, 22
and 23. Excavations and fills shall also comply with Chapter 33.
